title: The Gardner Museum Heist
caption:
Two "police officers" walked into a Boston museum at 1:24 AM. 81 minutes later, $500 million in art was gone. 🖼️

The guards were handcuffed in the basement, and the thieves even took the security tape.

Will the paintings ever come home? Tell us below 👇

scenes.say: Two police officers buzzed the door of a Boston museum. They weren't police. 1:24 AM, March 18, 1990.
The night guard, just 23, breaks protocol and buzzes them in.
Then one says, 'You look familiar. I think we have a warrant out for your arrest.'
Within minutes, both guards are handcuffed in the basement, wrapped in duct tape.
The thieves spend the next 81 minutes inside the Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum.
They smash gilded frames on marble floors. They slice canvases right off the stretchers.
Rembrandt's Storm on the Sea of Galilee, his only known seascape. Vermeer's The Concert. Works by Manet and Degas.
13 works in total, worth about $500 million. Then they drive off, and even take the security tape.
But here's the strangest part. The museum founder's will said nothing could ever be changed.
So the empty frames still hang today. A $10 million reward sits unclaimed.
The art has never been found. Is it hidden somewhere, or lost forever? Tell me in the comments.
